name: slashpages-browser-extension
description: Shows the slash pages of the current site, from its /.well-known/slashpages.

scripts.lint: eslint src test && web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files node_modules test dist eslint.config.js package-lock.json package.json README.md .github amo-metadata.json
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files node_modules test dist eslint.config.js package-lock.json package.json README.md .github icons/icon.svg amo-metadata.json
